message.content:
The problem that retrieval-augmented generation tries to address in knowledge-intensive NLP tasks is to improve the performance of large pre-trained language models by utilizing the stored factual knowledge they have acquired from a large dataset.

This approach involves training a model on a large pre-existing dataset, which enables it to learn from existing knowledge and improve its performance on downstream NLP tasks. The retrieved context suggests that retrieval-augmented generation can be used to enhance the capabilities of large pre-trained language models in various knowledge-intensive NLP tasks.
